comparison.objective: Fasten a flexible bracelet around a wrist form; candidate configures an industrial gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible-band wrapping and pin-clasp alignment versus rigid screw/nut adjustment and counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: Clasp closed around the wrist and released for three seconds versus locked angle retained through cycles.
comparison.reason: Clasp insertion and flexible wrapping are meaningfully different physical abilities.
